items.t: Moderna’s Experimental Ebola Vaccine Begins Landmark Trial In Uganda – MRNA Stock Eyes Fourth Straight Monthly Gain

items.t: Why Moderna’s Biggest New Questions May Make Sense Through ETFs
items.sum: If you like Moderna but hold it directly, your portfolio lives or dies with its own swings. Simply Wall St points to significant insider selling over the past 3 months, which can worry some investors. Owning Moderna inside a fund spreads that single business across a basket of companies. items.t: $1,000 in Moderna Stock on Jan. 1 Is Worth About $7,500 Today
